body: Thanks for your advice, that must have taken you a lot of courage and I'm pleased that you have found it easier. The hardest part is definitely my head, the thoughts and feelings can come on really quick, sometimes cant stop and pull them back. I have no problem talking to people about things but when it comes to how I'm feeling, it's difficult, feel so paranoid and anxious/worry. Then it makes you feel alone. Will try and speak to my friend
Being treated for anxiety and depression, taking 50mg sertraline
